title: Corrected complete-public-interface O0/O2 transfer test
purpose: Smallest corrected replacement for the withdrawn R5a size/rate transfer question under the remediated R6AF complete public interface.
epistemic_role: Prospective finite-grid transfer test of the complete two-stage public decoder. It is not a threshold, crossing, asymptotic scaling, mechanism-causality, fault-tolerance, or universal-dominance study.
scientific_question: On a wholly new two-size, two-rate matrix beyond the closed R6AF cells, does the paired O2-versus-O0 complete-pipeline direction remain present when every trajectory obeys the remediated signal-only, action-conditioned, relation-free public interface?

r5a_reusable_only: paper-normalized IID red-X physical-error model provenance
periodic coloured-honeycomb lattice and topology provenance
r5a_prohibited: O0 or O2 risks, paired differences, intervals, p-values, or stage counts
support-revealing first observations, sentinel-bearing second records, or relation/effective-truth charge inputs

frozen_model.physical_channel_and_geometry: Paper-normalized periodic coloured honeycomb with IID red-X edge errors at fixed p_X and p_Z=0. Physical winding is an unconditional terminal logical loss. Lattice construction, periodic boundaries, edge colours, and winding convention are identical to the frozen R6AF implementation.
frozen_model.first_observation_and_timing: Before any decoder action, expose only the flux syndrome plus one full-binary colour-resolved e_B/e_G signal field generated from the physical history. A zero must remain ambiguous about whether degree-two fusion occurred; support or latent fusion status is never public.

first_actions.O0: Unit-weight flux MWPM from the public flux syndrome.
first_actions.O2: Published signal-only herald-weight flux MWPM with w_e=1-n_e K and K=27L^2 from the same public first record.

frozen_model.second_observation_and_timing: After each arm realizes its own first correction, form that arm's private physical/correction Boolean union, terminate if it winds, then generate a separate full-binary second public charge record using the shared second exogenous key conditioned on that realized action. The two arms' second records need not be numerically equal.
frozen_model.public_charge_action: The same deterministic unit-weight blue/green charge decoder is used in both arms. It may consume only the known first correction and the full-binary second public charge record. It is relation-free: hidden relation components, active support, effective strings, sentinels, physical errors, and homology truth are forbidden inputs.
frozen_model.private_generation_and_scoring_boundary: Physical errors, Boolean unions, action-conditioned relation graphs, active supports, effective charge chains, and homology labels remain private and may be used only to generate a valid public record, verify support privately, and score the realized public actions.
frozen_model.one_changed_mechanism: Only the first-stage O0 versus O2 flux weights differ. Channel, geometry, observation timing, random-key coupling, charge action, tie convention, and scorer are fixed.

matched_randomness.independent_sampling_unit: One attempted physical red-X history at fixed (L,p_X), including terminal histories. O0 and O2 are paired arms within that history and are never counted as independent units.
matched_randomness.pairing_contract: Both arms consume identical physical and first-observation keys and the identical second-exogenous key. Second-record generation is nevertheless performed separately against each arm's action-conditioned private support.
matched_randomness.cross_cell_rule: Different (L,p_X) cells use disjoint key namespaces; no trajectory is reused across sizes or rates.

loss_and_denominator.primary_loss: One Boolean per attempted arm: physical winding OR first-stage physical/correction-union winding OR blue charge-residual winding OR green charge-residual winding.
loss_and_denominator.denominator: Every attempted physical history in the cell. Terminal physical winding and first-union winding remain in the denominator; conditioning on survival is prohibited.
loss_and_denominator.primary_estimand: Per-cell paired difference Delta(L,p_X)=R_O2-R_O0 in unconditional final Boolean-union loss.
loss_and_denominator.secondary_diagnostics: Per-arm unconditional risk and matched counts of physical-winding terminal, first-union terminal, charge-stage loss, and success. Stage counts are descriptive diagnostics only.

grid_and_budget.rationale: R6AF is closed at L=3,5 and p_X=0.19,0.21. The smallest wholly new matrix that discriminates both size and rate transfer uses two larger sizes (L=7,9) and two separated registered rates (p_X=0.17,0.21). No closed R6AF cell is restarted or duplicated, and the 2x2 design cannot support a threshold scan.
grid_and_budget.no_adaptive_extension: Stop at 512 histories per cell. No extra rate, size, history, or replicate may be added without a new manifest.

uncertainty_and_analysis.arm_intervals: Pointwise two-sided 90% Wilson intervals for unconditional O0 and O2 risks in every cell.
uncertainty_and_analysis.paired_interval: Pointwise two-sided 90% percentile interval for Delta from 10000 deterministic paired-history bootstrap replicates within each cell, bootstrap salt 68626.
uncertainty_and_analysis.discordance_diagnostic: Report O0-only and O2-only failures and the two-sided exact McNemar/binomial diagnostic for discordant pairs.
uncertainty_and_analysis.transfer_summary: Report all four cellwise estimates and intervals. Separately report independent-cell bootstrap contrasts Delta(9,p)-Delta(7,p) at each registered rate and Delta(L,0.17)-Delta(L,0.21) at each registered size; these describe effect heterogeneity and are not threshold or monotonicity fits.
uncertainty_and_analysis.multiplicity: All intervals are pointwise exploratory diagnostics. No family-wise, universal, or publication-level discovery claim is registered.

knowledge_states.bounded_transfer_supported: All four registered cells have upper paired 90% interval below zero, with every integrity gate passing. This supports only transfer on the registered finite grid.
knowledge_states.heterogeneous_or_nonuniversal: At least one new cell has a paired interval wholly above zero, or registered transfer contrasts show resolved sign heterogeneity. Report the localized boundary without overriding other cells.
knowledge_states.unresolved_at_cap: Any required new cell interval contains zero and no interval is wholly positive. Report unresolved at registered precision; do not enlarge sampling automatically.
knowledge_states.censored: Any integrity, anti-leak, action-binding, replay, completeness, or scorer gate fails. Preserve the witness and release no decoder comparison.

integrity_and_acceptance_gates: Before sampling, every frozen hash and the R6AF remediated-preflight status must match exactly; fail closed on any mismatch.
All first public observations are full-binary signal-only records with no support-revealing value or hidden latent field in the public transcript.
Every paired arm matches physical-error, first-observation, and second-exogenous keys exactly; the two second records are separately action-conditioned.
Every nonterminal second public record is full binary, passes its own private support check, and contains no -1 or inactive sentinel.
At fixed public second record and known first action, varying private relations/effective truth cannot change the charge action or public transcript.
Wrong-action binding fixtures must reject a second record when checked against a mismatched first action/support.
Each recorded final loss is replay-verified as the unconditional four-term Boolean union and every attempted history is retained in the denominator.
Deterministic replay of first, middle, and final trajectory in every cell reproduces keys, public transcripts, actions, stage status, and final loss for both arms.
All 2048 independent histories and 4096 arm evaluations complete with no duplicate keys, missing arms, censored denominators, or nonfinite weights before analysis is armed.
The future runner must refuse to arm bootstrap analysis until all structural, completeness, anti-leak, action-binding, scorer, and replay gates pass.
stop_rules: Stop before sampling on any unresolved interface/provenance field, frozen-hash mismatch, failed R6AF status, or unimplemented gate.

During future execution, stop and preserve the checkpoint on the first key mismatch, nonbinary record, hidden-field transcript leak, support violation, wrong-action acceptance, scorer mismatch, replay failure, duplicate, missing arm, or nonfinite weight.

Stop at 512 histories per cell even if the transfer result is unresolved. Do not adapt the p_X grid, add sizes, fit a crossing/threshold, or launch a downstream Lab 005 baseline in the same transition.
Do not numerically pool R4.5c, R6AF, R5a, or any other study with R6AJ; historical results are context only under their own evidence boundaries.
prohibited_claims_and_actions: restart, extend, or refine R6AE or R6AF
fit, bracket, interpolate, or estimate a crossing or threshold
claim universal O2 dominance, asymptotic scaling, or fault tolerance
reuse support-revealing BP evidence or any withdrawn R5a numerical result
condition charge action on private relations, support, effective truth, sentinels, or homology
sample, generate histories, arm evaluations, or bootstrap in this registration transition

registration_outcome.excluded_off_frontier_provenance: The aborted R6AI crossing-smoke artifacts contain 24 pre-transition first-stage trajectories. They are outside this contract and are never inputs to R6AJ.

next_action: In the next bounded transition, implement only the fail-closed R6AJ runner and deterministic integrity fixtures against this frozen contract; run zero production histories until every prospective gate is executable and passes.
